# assignmentB2CassieDavis

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

assignmentB2CassieDavis is a package that has a function called count_all_missing_by_group() that counts the number of missing values in a dataset. It groups observations by a selected variable and calculates how many missing variables there are in each column for each group, making it easier to identify missing data patterns across groups.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2CassieDavis from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github(
  "UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2CassieDavis",
  ref = "0.1.0")
```

## Example

This example uses the built-in `airquality` dataset to count
missing values in each column, grouped by month.

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2CassieDavis)

count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
